purpose: Maintainer links for Lua menu resources that server developers can integrate into FiveM resources.

items.name: MenuV
items.author: ThymonA
items.description: Standalone menu library with a browser-based interface. Use it to build menus in your own Lua resources.
requirements: Use the prebuilt archive from the release page. Keep the resource folder named menuv and start it before the resources that use it.

items.name: Ox Lib Context Menu
items.author: Overextended
items.description: Build nested menus with icons, descriptive options and callbacks using the context menu module in Ox Lib.
requirements: Install and start ox_lib before the resource that imports it. The context menu ships with the library.

items.name: qb-menu
items.author: QBCore
items.description: The menu resource for QBCore scripts, with headings, buttons and per-option icons.
requirements: Check whether your QBCore recipe already installed qb-menu. Start it before any resource that opens its menus.
